description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Lightning], [Awoken Stormborn], [Damage Cap +10000], and [Transparent Bolt] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Stormborn
description.text: Celerity and Support abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Celerity and Support abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Technical Rush after using a Celerity or Support ability

description.name: Transparent Bolt
description.text: Grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after using a Celerity or Support ability
